ideas.title: Send a small feedback policy, not a stale action chunk
ideas.nextStep: Test a learned observation-conditioned policy packet against an equally expressive cached-goal fast policy and delayed chunks. Audit contingency policies and real-time correction first. Preserve fresh-observation access equally; train and test on separate worlds. Do not replace the learned packet with oracle branch selection.

ideas.title: Train against worlds that look identical until the UAV investigates
ideas.nextStep: Construct observation-matched hidden-world pairs, prove their prefix observations match, then train a small recurrent sensing/navigation policy. Compare against matched domain randomization and an explicit belief planner. Preserve unknown geometry, teacher-only state and held-out topology; this is not a photorealistic simulator-addition claim.

ideas.title: Learn whether to think more, look closer, or move to see
ideas.nextStep: Train a small value-of-information router over semantic inference, a fresh crop, a safe reveal maneuver, and continue/brake. Make each resource solve a different controlled uncertainty and charge its measured wall-clock/motion cost. Compare learned routing to strong heuristics and equal-budget single-resource policies.

ideas.title: Choose camera motion for the time a model answer will arrive
ideas.nextStep: Implement delay-conditioned camera/body/capture co-control with rendered partial observations. Compare against current-visibility control, the same controller given delay, and execution-time prediction. Test whether changed sensing, rather than merely slower flight or forecasting, produces the benefit.

ideas.title: Repair only the parts of a semantic plan whose evidence changed
ideas.nextStep: Build an executable semantic dependency graph with unknown/false distinction and local re-grounding. Compare against whole-plan replanning and an equally informed incremental scene-graph baseline. Include actual visual grounding errors, not only perfect predicates; audit STeP, LabGuard, LTLCodeGen and LookasideVLN for equivalence.
